sloka: वानरोद्घुष्टघोषश्च राक्षसानां च निस्वनः।ज्याशब्दश्चापि रामस्य त्रयं व्याप दिशो दश ।। ६.७५.३७ ।।
transliteration: vānarodghuṣṭaghoṣaśca rākṣasānāṁ ca nisvanaḥ।jyāśabdaścāpi rāmasya trayaṁ vyāpa diśo daśa ।। 6.75.37 ।।

translations.english: Then, great Rama stretching his bow in great fury shone as though the divine Lord Siva was stretching his bow with imprints of Vedas.
